# Milepost — support and legal pages

The three public pages App Review has to be able to open without an account:
support and FAQ, the privacy policy, and the terms of use. Served by GitHub
Pages at <https://williamscott701.github.io/milepost-support/>.

**Do not edit the HTML here.** It is generated by
`scripts/make-support-site.py` in the app repo (private). Edit that file and
re-run it:

```bash
cd ../Milepost && python3 scripts/make-support-site.py
```

The same three URLs go into App Store Connect and into `LegalLinks` in the app.
